title: Road Vehicle Standards Amendment (Safer E-Bikes) Bill 2025
short_title: Road Vehicle Standards Amendment (Safer E-Bikes) Bill 2025

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would bring e-bikes under the Road Vehicle Standards Act 2018 and set national safety standards for them.

The Minister would be required to create road vehicle standards for electrically power-assisted cycles and powerful e-bikes, covering design features like anti-tampering protections and speed capability.
Vehicles that meet the standard, are designed for people with disability, or are intended for off-road use would be exempt from the regulations.
changes: Classifies electrically power-assisted cycles as road vehicles.
Creates a new vehicle class for powerful e-bikes.
Requires the Minister to set national road vehicle standards for both types of e-bikes.
summary.affected: Manufacturers, importers, and users of e-bikes in Australia.
